_readme: Voice roles for the Manual sandbox narration. Rendered by render.mjs through Voxxy (https://vox.delo.sh).

narrator-steady.label: Calm, warm man with beats of silence between ideas. Documentary pace.

design.description: A calm, warm man in his thirties, curious and gently wry, crisp articulation, unhurried documentary explainer pace
design.text: Imagine a very busy warehouse. Thousands of small messages fly around every minute, and somehow nothing gets lost. It sounds impossible, but the trick is surprisingly simple, and a little bit charming.

narrator-wry.label: Warm mid-range man, faintly smiling, more pitch movement, flows with fewer pauses.

design.description: A warm, mid-range man, faintly smiling, thoughtful and wry, precise diction, measured steady pace
design.text: Imagine a very busy warehouse. Thousands of small messages fly around every minute, and somehow nothing gets lost. It sounds impossible, but the trick is surprisingly simple, and a little bit charming.

narrator-alto.label: Calm, warm woman, curious and gently wry, science-explainer pace.

design.description: A calm, warm woman, curious and gently wry, crisp articulation, unhurried science explainer pace
design.text: Imagine a very busy warehouse. Thousands of small messages fly around every minute, and somehow nothing gets lost. It sounds impossible, but the trick is surprisingly simple, and a little bit charming.

tips-giddy.label: Very high, bright, nasal and giggly cartoon man, fast and bouncy.

design.description: A high-pitched, bright, nasal cartoon voice, bursting with giddy enthusiasm, giggly, fast and bouncy
design.text: Whoa, check this out! It's a super duper amazing thing, and it's so much fun! Ooh, ooh, you're gonna love it, I promise! Ha ha, it's the best!

tips-squeak.label: Squeaky, overexcited young cartoon character who laughs between phrases.

design.description: An overexcited young cartoon character, squeaky and nasal, laughing between phrases, super energetic
design.text: Whoa, check this out! It's a super duper amazing thing, and it's so much fun! Ooh, ooh, you're gonna love it, I promise! Ha ha, it's the best!

tips-bubbly.label: Bright, bubbly, goofy woman, breathless with excitement.

design.description: A bright, bubbly, excitable woman, nasal and goofy, high-pitched, breathless with excitement
design.text: Whoa, check this out! It's a super duper amazing thing, and it's so much fun! Ooh, ooh, you're gonna love it, I promise! Ha ha, it's the best!

floor-drone.label: Very low, flat, slow man. Mumbled, a bit lost, lots of dead air.

design.description: A slow, deadpan middle-aged man, flat and mumbling, a little confused, awkward pauses, quietly confident
design.text: Yeah. So. I stamped that one. I think it was the blue one. No, the other one. Anyway. It's done. Probably.

floor-mumble.label: Low monotone man, hesitant, unsure but trying to sound sure.

design.description: A low, monotone man speaking slowly and hesitantly, mumbling, unsure but trying to sound sure, long awkward pauses
design.text: Yeah. So. I stamped that one. I think it was the blue one. No, the other one. Anyway. It's done. Probably.

floor-dazed.label: Tired, dazed man, slightly more pitch movement, halting delivery.

design.description: A tired, deadpan man, dazed and distracted, slow halting delivery, mumbles his words
design.text: Yeah. So. I stamped that one. I think it was the blue one. No, the other one. Anyway. It's done. Probably.
